title: ADA Reported-Property Column Specification Registry
description: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification reported-property column definitions derived from technique TAPP workbooks. Each $def constrains one column of the reported-property table -- the variables a procedure REPORTS, as distinct from the analytes and channels it acquires. TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs so they resolve locally through the building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties of its own.

geochron_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
geochron_detectionLimitMethod.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the session detection limit reported above.

geochron_limitOfQuantificationMethod.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
geochron_limitOfQuantificationMethod.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the limit of quantification: the lowest concentration reliably measurable with acceptable precision and accuracy.
